title: cli-doctor-command
description: Root Cause: No way to diagnose Dippy installation issues. What To Do: 1) Create src/dippy/cli/doctor.py with run() 2) Implement 5 checks: installation (on PATH, version), hook status, config validation (parse, includes), log health (writable), agent-specific when --agent. 3) Use checkmark/cross indicators, exit codes 0/1/2. Acceptance Criteria: all 5 checks run, clear indicators, --agent filter works, --verbose works. Dependencies: cli-add-subcommand-infrastructure, cli-create-agent-detection-module

title: cli-hooks-install-command
description: Root Cause: Users must manually edit JSON config files to install Dippy hooks. What To Do: 1) Create src/dippy/cli/hooks.py with install() function 2) Implement dippy hooks install with --agent and --global flags 3) Hook installation: read config, check for existing Dippy hook, insert hook entry, write back 4) Output summary. Acceptance Criteria: installs to specified agent, no duplicate entries, preserves other hooks, creates dir if missing, handles JSON errors. Dependencies: cli-add-subcommand-infrastructure, cli-create-agent-detection-module

title: cli-add-subcommand-infrastructure
description: Root Cause: Current dippy CLI has no subcommand support. Need argparse subparsers for hooks and doctor while maintaining backward compatibility. What To Do: 1) Modify parse_cli_args() in dippy.py to add subparsers 2) Add subcommands group with hooks and doctor 3) Route to dedicated handlers 4) Ensure backward compatibility with --cmd, --stdin, --claude, --gemini 5) Add placeholder imports for cli modules. Acceptance Criteria: dippy --help shows subcommands, dippy hooks --help works, dippy doctor --help works, dippy --cmd still works, all existing tests pass. Output Files: src/dippy/dippy.py

title: cli-update-readme-documentation
description: Root Cause: README installation section does not match dev workflow and new CLI commands need docs. What To Do: 1) Update Installation section - clarify Homebrew for users, pip install -e for dev 2) Add CLI Commands section - document hooks install/uninstall/list and doctor 3) Add Troubleshooting section linking to doctor. Acceptance Criteria: clear user vs dev install, new commands documented, existing CLI mode preserved. Dependencies: cli-hooks-list-command, cli-doctor-command

title: cli-create-agent-detection-module
description: Root Cause: Hook management needs to know which agents are installed and where their config files live. No centralized registry exists. What To Do: 1) Create src/dippy/cli/__init__.py 2) Create src/dippy/cli/agents.py with AgentInfo dataclass, AGENTS dict, detect_agents() and resolve_dippy_command() functions 3) Define all 8 agents: claude, gemini, cursor, windsurf, pi-mono, moltbot, codex, pearai with their config paths and hook formats. Acceptance Criteria: detect_agents() returns installed agents, correct config paths for global and project, unit tests with mock filesystem, all 8 agents defined. Output Files: src/dippy/cli/__init__.py, src/dippy/cli/agents.py, tests/cli/test_agents.py

title: cli-hooks-uninstall-command
description: Root Cause: Users must manually remove Dippy hook entries from JSON configs. What To Do: 1) Add uninstall() to hooks.py 2) Implement dippy hooks uninstall with --agent and --global flags 3) Remove Dippy hook entry from config, cleanup empty hooks array. Acceptance Criteria: removes hook from config, safe no-op when not installed, preserves other hooks. Dependencies: cli-create-agent-detection-module, cli-hooks-install-command

title: cli-hooks-list-command
description: Root Cause: No way to see which agents have Dippy hooks installed. What To Do: 1) Add list_() to hooks.py 2) Detect all agents and check hook status 3) Display table with checkmarks for installed hooks. Acceptance Criteria: shows all 8 agents, correct indicators, distinguishes global vs project. Dependencies: cli-create-agent-detection-module
